name: gh_search_issues
description: Search issues by keywords in title and body (GET /search/issues)

q.description: The query contains one or more search keywords. Matched against issue titles and bodies.

repo.description: Limit results to a repository, owner/repo form (the repo: qualifier in the real API).

state.description: Filter by issue state: open or closed (the state: qualifier in the real API).

limit.description: The number of results per page (max 100). GitHub param: per_page. Default: 30.
